docs.text:
The four hundred quatrains of Jain ascetics on virtue, wealth and love, one of the great Tamil moral anthologies after the Kural, with Pope’s Tamil text, translation and notes.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned and hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Munivar arulicceyta Nalatiyar = The Naladiyar, or, Four hundred quatrains in Tamil · Pope, G. U. (George Uglow), 1820-1908 · 1893, 514 scanned pages. Published 1893; George Uglow Pope died 1908; the verses are medieval; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
